license_summary: All selected source recordings are offered under CC0 1.0 on the linked Freesound source pages. Attribution is optional under CC0; credits are included for provenance.
download_note: Downloaded publicly exposed Freesound high-quality MP3 preview assets. Original full-quality WAV/FLAC downloads require an account, so delivered WAVs are decoded/edited from compressed MP3 previews. No login, signup, paid assets, video extraction, TTS, or external generation API was used.
validation: All six source MP3 files decoded successfully with macOS afconvert; all five output WAVs reopened with Python wave, had nonzero signal and duration, and were decoded again by afconvert. Metadata and checksums below. No subjective listening verification is claimed.
